shattered-pixel-dungeon.why: Java roguelike with about 1,300 source files: combat, hit and loot rules are real code with buffs, early exits and order-sensitive formulas, but small enough to check by hand.

egameplay.why: Unity C# combat framework from a Chinese developer: Excel config tables, Unity .asset skill configs with formula strings, mixed UTF-8 and GBK source. Formulas live in code, values in config, and some config is not wired into the code.
